execution: Official MCP SDK stdio: client.call_tool for every SCM construction, native netlist export and native calculation.
oracle_provenance: Independent complex nodal systems and closed-form step responses for declared fixture values. Native values come only from FASTMEAN CSV exports. Assigned fixture values are not original textbook outputs.

tolerances.transient_voltage: After source rise/first timestep: absolute voltage error <=0.001*max(1 V,abs(ideal output at requested stop time)).

phase_exclusions: Phase at the ideal RLC transfer zero is undefined and excluded. Its exact notch check requests magnitude only.

native_transient_limitation.known_limitation: Observed native transient timeouts for the ideal voltage-source/capacitor loop; required numerical acceptance is AC-only.
native_transient_limitation.future_preflight_note: Skip this known timeout-prone transient topology unless explicitly testing native transient support. No native preflight rejection was exported.
native_transient_limitation.observed: Both layout modes timed out after 15 s with DC excitation and again with delayed 100 us / finite-rise 1 us pulse excitation. No numerical samples or transient/DC pass is claimed.
native_transient_limitation.required_acceptance: Primary and uncompensated secondary AC passed in both layouts.

visual_review.general_quality: Readable with real orthogonal wires; no observed collisions or accidental junctions.
visual_review.guided_changes: Aligned ports with escape rails; compensated divider has a straight balanced midpoint bus; RLC output rail is straight.
automatic_reference_arrangement_differen: Battery divider upper resistor is horizontal rather than vertical.
Compensated divider uses a spine with upper/lower parallel branches rather than two vertical columns.
RLC capacitor is above its feed inductor instead of below.
Numbered ladder terminals use named tap ports and short marker leads.
Current-divider sole output is a right-facing upper-rail elbow above the source column, rather than a terminal beyond the far-right load; this remains a readable automatic layout choice.
glyph_differences: Native rectangular resistors instead of textbook zigzags.
Circular ideal voltage sources instead of battery glyphs.
Analysis ground added where source image omits it.
visual_review.scope: Reference-guided fidelity and general automatic readability are distinct; no pixel-identical claim.
